mentions.name: Chase Travel UI rebuild
mentions.description: A rebuilt version of the Chase Travel booking interface, redesigned by a former JPMorgan Chase engineer to make the travel UI significantly better than the original.
mentions.problem: The existing Chase Travel UI has a poor user experience (it "sucks"), and the author never got a role on that team while at JPMorgan Chase to fix it.
